summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted following a fall from his wheelchair four days prior, resulting in a right intertrochanteric femur fracture and right tibia/fibula fracture. Given his baseline paraplegia and comorbidities, non-operative management with bracing was chosen over surgery. He received closed reduction in the emergency department, with stable alignment confirmed on follow-up imaging. His pain was well controlled, and he engaged in physical therapy while in the hospital. A concurrent urinary tract infection was treated with amoxicillin-clavulanate. He remained neurologically stable, with no complications during his stay. He was discharged home with home health services, a new wheelchair, and detailed instructions for non-weight-bearing status, skin care, anticoagulation, and medication management.
